newsitem.title: USA: Busch to drop ads knocking Samuel Adams beer.
newsitem.headline: Busch to drop ads knocking Samuel Adams beer.

text.p: The National Advertising Division of the Council of Better Business Bureaus Inc said Monday Anheuser-Busch Cos Inc agreed to stop advertising claims about Samuel Adams beer found to be unsupported.

Boston Beer Co Inc, brewer of Samuel Adams beers, challenged the truthfulness and accuracy of Anheuser-Busch's advertising that included: "Why does Sam Adams pretend to come from New England when the truth is, it's brewed and bottled by contract breweries all around the country?" and "Time to stop tricking beer drinkers, Jim."

The Council said that, while Samuel Adams is brewed and bottled by contract breweries outside New England, it has asked Anheuser-Busch not imply Boston Brewing does not control the brewing of its beers at the contract breweries, or that Samuel Adams is the same quality as the low-priced beers these brewers also make.
Anheuser-Busch's advertising agency of record is DDB Needham of Chicago.
